name: Java21 + Spring Boot
limits: JVM memory and library compatibility; pin Boot4.1 patch
learn: HTTP lifecycle, DI, JDBC transaction boundary
deliver: M03 quote API and unit/integration suite
prove: Explain rollback when exception is swallowed

name: REST / OpenAPI
limits: No streaming optimization; breaking semantics need version
prove: Explain why POST timeout does not mean failure

name: React / TypeScript
problem: Accessible role-based UI and server-state handling
limits: UI types do not validate network at runtime
learn: router, TanStack Query, forms, runtime validation
prove: Distinguish UI optimistic cache from booking authority

name: PostgreSQL / Flyway
problem: Owned durable aggregates and interval integrity
limits: Physical instance shared dev still has one failure domain
learn: SQL, MVCC, locks, exclusion, plans, migration
prove: Explain write skew and why Redis lock is insufficient

name: Redis
problem: Bounded catalog cache and gateway throttling
limits: Eviction and stale data; never inventory truth
learn: TTL, memory max, noeviction vs allkeys-lru, persistence
prove: Prove stale cache cannot change quote price

name: RabbitMQ
limits: Queue topology and confirms need explicit ops
prove: Explain confirm success without consumer business effect

name: Kafka comparative lab
limits: Not installed core; partitions and rebalance costs
learn: offsets, key ordering, retention, group rebalances
prove: Explain ordering per key vs global ordering

name: Keycloak / OIDC
limits: IdP availability and token revocation semantics
learn: PKCE, JWKS rotation, JWT audience, RBAC
deliver: M02 two tenants and revoke role

name: Linux / DNS / TLS / Nginx
limits: Need operational skills, not host security changes here
deliver: M01 lab and M15 network packet evidence
prove: Explain DNS failure vs HTTP503 vs connection refused

name: Docker / Compose
limits: Volumes consume disk; Compose not HA
deliver: M01 immutable image and clean environment
prove: Explain restart vs recreation vs lost volume

name: Kubernetes / Helm
limits: Cluster overhead; DB HA not supplied by StatefulSet
prove: Explain readiness vs liveness with broker down

name: GitHub Actions
limits: Remote runner costs/permissions, local fallback scripts
learn: DAG, caches, artifacts, OIDC, environment gates
prove: Explain why path filter can miss shared contract changes

name: OpenTofu / Ansible
problem: Cloud resource state + repeatable VM configuration
limits: State secrets/lock, billing; Ansible not resource graph
deliver: M17 sandbox plan and local VM convergence
prove: Explain IaC state vs actual resources and second run

name: AWS optional sandbox
limits: Real account optional and spending approval required
deliver: M17 local simulation or authorized sandbox report
prove: Explain single VM production-like single failure point

name: OpenTelemetry / Prometheus / Grafana / Loki / Tempo
problem: Trace slow saga with metrics and logs
limits: Storage/label cardinality cost; sampling changes visibility
deliver: M12 diagnose poisoned event with correlation
prove: Find trace across async edge without logging JWT

name: JUnit / Testcontainers / Playwright / k6 / ZAP
problem: Verify real transactions, UI, load and access attacks
limits: Tests consume resources; synthetic fixture only
learn: test levels, fault injection, percentiles, attack scope
prove: Explain why 100% line coverage does not prove invariants

name: ADRs / threat model / contract review
prove: Explain where strong consistency ends and manual review begins
